_comment: Documentation for secrets.json (gitignored). `devenv setup` writes secrets.json from this file, taking values from `--secrets <file>` (a filled secrets.json, e.g. the one kept as a Document in the k8s-secrets-dev vault) and otherwise prompting for the required ones. A value here is the key's 1Password location in op://vault/item/field notation, for humans: devenv never runs the 1Password CLI. Keys starting with _ are comments: _KEY describes KEY, any other _Name describes the keys below it. Nothing in this file is secret. Ask Ive if an item is missing in 1Password.
_FRONTEND: verisk-nordics-frontend (apps/dss/.env). Item Dev02-frontend: name to be confirmed when the item is created (DSS-5590); the values are also in the Vercel dev02 project.
_NEXTAUTH_SECRET: NextAuth cookie encryption key. Any long random string works locally; the shared dev value is in 1Password.
_NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_SECRET: Client secret of the ROPC identity client (ropc_client) used by the frontend against the dev02 identity server.
_NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSETS_BASE: Base URL of the static assets bucket (login page image etc.). Not secret, but environment specific; also visible in the Vercel dev02 project.
_OKTA_CLIENT_SECRET: Client secret of the frontend's Okta app on the dev02 server (client 0oa2ta051dgJQg8jd0h8). Without it Okta login ends in 'We could not start verification'.
_MONGO_BRIDGE_DEV_AUTH_TOKEN: Optional. Token for the news/Mongo bridge; leave blank if you do not work on news.
_AZURE_AD: Optional. Only for the Azure AD SSO login path; leave blank for Okta email-code login.
_LIBERTINE: Item Dev02 holds the flat kubernetes secret of the dev02 cluster; its field names are the $Placeholder names of the appsettings templates.
_OKTA_INTERNAL_SECRET: Okta_InternalServices_Secret for the dev02 AWS server (client 0oa2ta051fvbwMCpr0h8). Used by libertine and every local service to call other services. Required.
_SERVICES: Below: only needed when a backend service runs locally (devenv up --local <name>). Which ones a service needs depends on its template; devenv tells you when a required one is blank. Optional ones stay as op:// references until you fill them.
_DB_PASSWORD: Password of SQL user 'libertine' on mssql-internal.test.mavera.claims.verisk.com (dev02 database). Required for every service with a database.
_CRYPTO: CryptoSettings IV and key shared by evaluation and document services (field encryption). Optional for a smoke test, needed for real case data.
_SMB: Legacy file share used by evaluation-service for old case files. Leave blank unless you need those.
_S3: Object storage for document-service on dev02 (DSS-5604). Needed to open documents through a local document-service; blank ones fall back to the fleet compose defaults (MinIO), which do not exist outside the compose stack.
_MAIL_SMS: notification-service only. With --allow-mail the local service sends EVERY mail to MAIL_TEST_ADDRESS (your own address) because MailEnvironment is Development; MAIL_API_KEY/ID are the SendGrid credentials from the dev02 secret, without them sending fails harmlessly.
_MAIL_TEST_ADDRESS: Your own e-mail address; personal, so no 1Password reference.
_LEGACY: Pre-Okta internal-services secret and system account; only templates that still carry $InternalServicesSettings_* use them.
_OKTA_INTEGRATION_CLIENT_ID: integration only: client id of the public Integration API's Okta app on the dev02 server (not in the fleet compose). Blank boots the service with external auth disabled.
_TESTING: Optional. A dev02 user with a plain password login (IdentityServer, no Okta e-mail code) that `devenv token` and the Claude Code skills use for API checks. Item to be created in the vault (DSS-5647).
